CommunityApplications.Profile:
Dedicated game server containers for Unraid.
Currently maintained here: **ARK: Survival Ascended**, a SteamCMD-based dedicated server. ASA ships no native Linux server binary, so the container installs the Windows depot and runs it under GE-Proton.
The layout follows ich777's game server containers — the same `/serverdata/steamcmd` and `/serverdata/serverfiles` split, the same `UID`/`GID`/`VALIDATE` environment variables, and the same approach of downloading the game files on first boot so the image itself stays small.
Support is through GitHub issues: https://github.com/blckassassin/ArkSA/issues
